test_title: PYST 75: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 30 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: E, F, G, H, P, Q, and R, are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Only three people sit between H and R when counted from the right of R. Q sits second to the left of R. G sits fourth to the right of Q. F is an immediate neighbour of Q. P is NOT an immediate neighbour of H. Who sits second to the right of P?
solution:
Given: E, F, G, H, P, Q and R are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

Only three people sit between H and R when counted from the right of R.

Q sits second to the left of R.

G sits fourth to the right of Q.

F is an immediate neighbour of Q.

P is not an immediate neighbour of H.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9753b8d1d14ac094a3f0b0c45ceb9aa3bfcb88a35847ca3967d4ce9ba8f137f2.png] 

So, second to the right of P is E.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
